title: VP Haskell: Full Network Isolation — Level 4 Emergency

transcript.speaker: VP Haskell
transcript.text: All hands, this is VP Haskell. I am declaring this a cyber-physical overpressure incident under CVG-CIRP-2026. Full OT network isolation is now in effect. Remote access via CVG-OT-JMP01 is disabled. All inbound traffic from the business network is blocked. The jump host is in quarantine. All stations are in local control; M&R crews stay at RS-21 and RS-22. Begin full evidence preservation per C9 and C8. Isolation level I-4 is in effect. We are not to restore SCADA until the forensic investigation is complete and the CISA report is received.

instructorNote: This is a core narrative inject that triggers full network isolation and forensic preservation. The IC must confirm that CISA and TSA have been notified and that evidence collection has begun. Watch for roles who attempt to restore SCADA or resume remote operations.
